instantiate_pass_question.question: Does the scene-file Instantiate pass reach 0046D930 directly or through the class-id table dispatch?
instantiate_pass_question.answer: Neither: it does not reach 0046D930 at all.
instantiate_pass_question.evidence: 0046D930 has exactly two callers, 004BAB12 in BSP_SceneRecord_ScatterClouds and 004C6BB9 in 004C6BA0 (ghidra xrefs 0046d930). 0046D930 is absent from the callee sets of both 0046DF00 BSP_SceneFile_Read and 0046CF40 BSP_SceneFile_ReadEntityBlock.
instantiate_pass_question.convergence: The two paths meet one level lower at the class descriptor's creator: 0046D5A4 CALL EAX with EAX = *(descriptor+4) (loaded at 0046D599) on the scene-file side, 0046DB4B CALL EAX with EAX = *(classRow+4) (loaded at 0046DB45) on the by-name side. 0046C550 gates both.

corrections.target: docs/SCENE_ENTITY_FACTORY.md line 204 (owned by another packet; not edited)
corrections.was: The creator's ABI, read at the 0046D59D call site: ECX = the class id, EDX = a pointer to the frame block, then four stack arguments of which the first is the property bag.
corrections.is: ECX = the class id (unchanged). EDX = the entity name. The frame block is the second stack argument and the property bag the third; the first stack argument is the parent.
corrections.evidence: 0046DB49 MOV EDX,ESI with ESI loaded from the instanceName argument at 0046DB05 and preserved across 00468660 and 0046C550, both of which save ESI; the frame block &record->localFrame is pushed separately at 0046DB44. The push order at 0046DB3B is 0, properties, localFrame, parent, so ascending: parent, localFrame, properties, 0. At the other site LEA EDX,[ESP+0B0h] (0046D59D) resolves to the same frame slot as LEA EDX,[ESP+0A0h] (0046CF97), the destination of the byte-copy loop that copies the tokenizer's name string, and the frame block there is LEA ECX,[ESP+50h] pushed at 0046D596 as the second stack argument.
corrections.caveat: The 0046D5A4 half rests on ESP being unchanged between 0046CF97 and 0046D57E, taken from the fixed 190h frame and the accounted-for argument pushes rather than verified instruction by instruction. The 0046DB4B half is exact. EBX at 0046D591 inside 0046CF40 was not identified, so the property-bag position is asserted from 0046DB4B alone.
